improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 55% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
improve.coach: Flagged 36% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

improve.title: Playing forward
tips: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
improve.coach: Steady at about 36% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one. Shows up in 82% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You touched the ball more than a nervous waiter touches a menu. 55% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.
